headline: Indian Equities Plunge Over 1.7% as Banking Sell-Off Breaks Rally
summary: The Nifty 50 slumped 1.75% to 25,349.65 and the Sensex dropped 1.77% to 82,435.99, ending a four-week rally as lenders slid and the Indian rupee weakened against the US dollar.
why: Indian benchmark indices represent one of the largest emerging equity markets, with banking constituents holding substantial index weighting.

impacts.why: Plunged 450.95 points or 1.75% as heavy banking liquidation halted a four-week winning streak.
